invariant: Only trusted TLS service peers reach the shared issuer handlers, and stalled peers cannot block other connections.
required_evidence: Both authorized hosts in Debug and ASan/UBSan
Complete existing P00-P10 acceptance and unchanged acceptance lock
Independent Python TLS peers and OpenSSL actor proofs
limitations: The production issuer client and authenticated world sessions remain required.
Service certificates do not grant actor or owner authority.
Trust changes require restart; online service-certificate revocation is not implemented.
Immediate live world revocation and nonempty bootstrap profiles remain required.
